cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a riverside pavilion tower over the Yangtze — standing; a small present-day neighborhood outdoor cinema before the screening — she settles into a canvas chair and peels a mandarin for her own snack; a private orbital hotel room with a soft amber bedside reading light and an opaque shuttered window — After a nap she sits up and stretches her legs forward; an empty indoor wave-pool spectator bench after swimming — She shakes trapped water from a removable silicone swimming cap; a present-day public riverside chess terrace on a bright autumn afternoon — she solves a chess endgame on her own; a museum hands-on workshop table before opening — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a rocky coast path with tide pools — standing; a modern rooftop vegetable garden with a shaded dining alcove — She gives a ripe peach a careful first bite while watching the city; a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — chest-deep in the water; inside a knightly order's campaign pavilion — sets a cup down on the surface in front of her; an old stone chapel lit by candles — holds a small bouquet in both hands at her waist; a backstage dressing room with a bulb-lit mirror — holds one end of a towel hung around her neck; a Three Kingdoms festival street — standing
